item.title: Character Speech
item.description: Choose Edge or provider-based speech synthesis.

speak.enableHint: Enable Character Speech on the left first.

speechLanguage.label: Reading Language
speechLanguage.description: When set to auto, it follows the language defined by the character. If the text language differs from the reading language, the text is translated with an LLM before being read aloud; the bubble still shows the original text. This also applies to real-time conversation reading.

speak.testText: Hello, I'm your desktop sprite assistant!

item.title: Spontaneous Utterances
item.description: Control the frequency and style of spontaneous utterances and view history.

header.title: Spontaneous Utterances
header.description: Let the sprite proactively say something based on context, with a searchable history.

enabled.title: Enable Spontaneous Utterances
enabled.descriptionOn: When idle, the sprite will proactively generate a sentence within the frequency limits.
enabled.descriptionOff: History is kept when disabled, but nothing new is generated.

latestSpoken.title: Last Spoken
latestSpoken.empty: No spontaneous utterances to show yet

cooldown.label: Cooldown
cooldown.description: The minimum interval between two AI spontaneous utterances.

dailyLimit.label: Daily Limit
dailyLimit.description: Avoid interrupting you too often during highly active periods.

tone.title: Style Preference
tone.label: Preferred Tone
tone.description: Only a preference. When the context is stronger, the current state still takes priority.

intents.title: Allowed Categories
intents.hint: Keep at least one category so the sprite retains a generatable scope.

encouragement.label: Encouragement
encouragement.description: Leans toward cheering you on and keeping you moving

reminder.label: Reminder
reminder.description: Lightly reminds you of tasks, pace, and points to note

empathy.label: Empathy
empathy.description: Focuses more on comfort and companionship

planning.label: Planning
planning.description: Leans toward next steps and scheduling suggestions

playful.label: Playful
playful.description: Leans toward light jokes and witty expression

history.count: Showing the latest {{count}} records, including spoken, skipped, and failed events.
history.empty: No spontaneous utterance records under the current filters.

card.noText: No displayable text was generated this time.

reasons.generation_in_progress: A generation task is already in progress
reasons.intent_overrepresented: Too many recent utterances of the same category
reasons.intent_filtered: Generated category is outside the allowed range
reasons.first_activity_timeout: Timed out waiting for the model's first response
reasons.stream_idle_timeout: Model output interrupted and timed out
reasons.generation_max_timeout: Total generation time exceeded the limit

item.title: Speech Recognition Service
item.description: Real-time speech recognition that converts speech to text.

recognition.lockedHint: Speech recognition is a growth-type capability. The settings page and runtime service are only available after it is unlocked.

description.running: The service is running. You can use real-time speech recognition in the recording window. Closing the recording window does not stop the service.
description.stopped: The speech recognition model will load after starting. Control the service via the switch or the right-click menu.

chatEntry.description: When enabled, double-clicking the desktop sprite opens a small input window that follows the sprite, showing only the model, microphone, and send entry. Other conversation options continue to use the local cache.

detail.title: Mini Chat Box
detail.descriptionOn: Double-clicking the desktop sprite opens a small input window that follows the sprite.
detail.descriptionOff: Double-clicking the desktop sprite opens the full chat window.

chatEntry.setFailed: Failed to configure the mini input window

capability.lockedEnablePrerequisites: Prerequisite capabilities must be enabled first: {{names}}
capability.lockedUnlockPrerequisites: Prerequisite capabilities must be unlocked first: {{names}}
capability.lockedNotOpen: This capability is not yet available in this version
capability.lockedGeneric: This capability is not unlocked yet
capability.unavailableHint: This capability is currently unavailable; related features cannot be used.
